elements.caption: This Module works only with HIKVISION and ANNKE Cameras. First you need to configure Smart Events in the Camera Setup.
Please note : In your Camera configuration the System/security/Web-Authentication  needs to be set to digest/basic
Then you need to configure the Webhook call in the Camera Alarmserver (extended Network Setting)
After a HIKVISION Camera has send an Event to the Symcon  WebHook a set of variables will be created for each Camera.
The Top Level variable is the Camera Name. Below the IP-Adress, Date+Time of the Event, Password, User Name, Picture of the last Event
If your Cameras have different Passwords/User IDS`s you need to enter the correct Data into the relevant Variable
Please Note for this Module to work you need to first install the Egg Timer Module from the IP-Symcon Modul Store

elements.name: MotionActive
elements.caption: Duration the Motion Event stays activ in seconds

elements.name: ProcessDurationEvents
elements.caption: Process generic Hikvision duration events
elements.tooltip: If enabled, Hikvision eventType=duration events are processed as valid generic alarms. Disable only if these events cause false alarms.

elements.name: CurlTimeout
elements.caption: cURL Timeout (Seconds)
elements.tooltip: Maximum total time in seconds for each Smart Event camera request. Smart Event connection establishment is limited to the lower of this value or 3 seconds. Snapshot handling retains its existing timeout behavior.

elements.name: SnapshotRetryCount
elements.caption: Snapshot Retries
elements.tooltip: Number of times to retry downloading a snapshot if the camera is busy or times out (cURL error 28) or returns HTTP 503.

elements.name: MaxParallelCameras
elements.caption: Maximum cameras processed in parallel
elements.tooltip: Maximum number of IP-Symcon worker threads used when enabling or disabling Smart Events. Commands to each individual camera remain sequential.

elements.name: SmartCommandDelayMs
elements.caption: Delay between commands to the same camera (ms)
elements.tooltip: Minimum delay in milliseconds between completed ISAPI requests sent to the same camera. Different cameras are processed in parallel.

elements.name: SmartCommandRetryCount
elements.caption: Smart command retries
elements.tooltip: Number of retries after temporary network errors, timeouts, HTTP 408/429/5xx responses, or Hikvision deviceBusy/serviceUnavailable responses.
